title.narrative: Strengthening of Territorial Planning Processes in the Department of Caldas within the framework of the New Urban Agenda and the Sustainable Development Goals

description.narrative: The current project arises in the context of updating the national territorial planning instruments, the Land Use Plan – (POT by their acronyms in Spanish), and the Departmental Management Plans - POD, which are the main means to implement planning guidelines in the territories. In this specific case, the department of Caldas seeks to promote that its various municipalities achieve progress in this process and consolidate their respective POT, in addition to implementing a POD that provides overall guidelines and a territorial vision at the regional level, which provides clear guidelines to the municipalities to achieve a true articulation in promoting sustainable regional development. To achieve the above, and to have a clear understanding of the elements that make up the department, the IPT methodology, Territorial Prosperity Index, will be implemented to understand and characterize in a clear and precise manner, the different structural indicators that are the necessary basis to obtain a prosperous and sustainable territory, which meets the environmental requirements and challenges currently faced by the administrations. This methodology performs an analysis focused on elements of governance, mobility, finances, employment, gender, equity, among others, to provide a clear starting point where it is evident what potentialities or shortcomings persist in the territory, and what is the best route of action to address them. On the other hand, to complement and achieve concrete actions on the territories, the project will profile 2 Structuring Territorial Operations – (OTe by their acronyms in Spanish, understood as urban intelligence exercises focused on strategic areas of the department, which seek to enhance relevant elements representative at cultural, socioeconomic and environmental level, in order to promote the creation of regional scale centralities, and that include productive, tourist, industrial, housing, among others. The objective of this component is to promote quality of life through a cluster of services and employment where the population converges without distinctions around safe and inclusive urban elements. Finally, in order to strategically position Caldas at the national and international level, advice will be provided in the development of the National Urban Forum, as well as support in the presentation of actions and strategic elements of the department at the World Urban Forum.
